notes.title: Update 1.03 — Latin Spanish & Brazilian Portuguese Now Available!
notes.notes:
[p]Today’s update is especially close to our hearts — [i]Carnal Contract[/i] now includes [b]Latin American Spanish[/b] and [b]Brazilian Portuguese[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]We know how passionate the gaming community is across Latin America and Brazil, and how much you’ve been asking for this. It was really important to us that you can fully experience the story in your own language, and we’re thrilled to finally deliver it.[/p][p][/p][p]From now on, you can switch to Spanish or Portuguese directly in the [b]settings menu[/b] and enjoy [i]Carnal Contract[/i] the way it was meant to be played.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Keep in mind, both Latin American Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese will go through one more proofreading round this week, so if you notice any mistakes, they will be fixed in the coming days.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]But we’re not stopping here. The [b]next language will be Russian[/b], which we expect to release in the [b]first week of October[/b]. After that, in October, we’ll announce which other language we’ll begin working on next. Step by step, we want [i]Carnal Contract[/i] to feel welcoming and accessible to players all around the world.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting us, for spreading the word, and for being part of this community. Every message we get from you motivates us to keep improving, and making [i]Carnal Contract[/i] better with every update.[/p][p][/p][p]— [b]Dotty Diaries[/b][/p][p][/p][p]
[i]Update 1.03 — Patch Notes[/i][/p][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Latin American Spanish language support[/p][/*][*][p]Brazilian Portuguese language support[/p][/*][*][p]Traditional Chinese language support[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Minor Changes / Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where one gallery render could not be unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some mistakes in Simplified Chinese support[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor grammatical errors[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p align="start"][url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F52JuSBvd5t"]Discord – Join our community, chat, and ask questions.[/url][/p]

notes.title: Carnal Contract Update 1.01 - New Achievements & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve just released a new update that adds [b]18 new achievements[/b] to the game, along with a round of bug fixes and small improvements.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who reported issues and shared feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][i]Update 1.01 patch notes[/i][/p][p][b]New Content[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 18 new achievements.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Minor changes / Bugfixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed missing audio file crash.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed wrong character attribution.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect render in a flashback scene.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor grammatical errors.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support, reviews, and feedback. They mean a lot and help the game reach more players. We’ll keep working on polishing the experience and preparing for future updates.[/p][p][/p][p]Until next time,
Dotty[/p]

notes.title: The Game Is Approved – Release This Wednesday!
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]Great news - our game has officially been [b]approved by Steam[/b]! After weeks of waiting, reviews, and back-and-forth, everything is finally cleared. That means we are ready to launch on [b]Wednesday, August 27th[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]This extra time allowed us to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Polish the final build[/b] and make sure performance and stability are where we want them to be.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Finish proofreading[/b] so the English script flows smoothly.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Add achievements and final touches[/b] that make the experience more rewarding.[/p][/*][/list][p]We know it’s been a rollercoaster with delays and the review process, and we want to sincerely thank you for your patience and support. Every wishlist, every kind comment, and every bit of encouragement has meant the world to us during these last stressful weeks.[/p][p][/p][p]Mark your calendars: [b]Wednesday is the day![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860855/11de3eea346041367f155e54c29011c09ba0d614.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you’d like to get even closer to the action, come join our [b]official Discord community[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Inside, you’ll find:[/p][list][*][p]Sneak peeks and preview images before they appear anywhere else[/p][/*][*][p]Updates and news straight from the dev team[/p][/*][*][p]Help & tips if you ever get stuck in the game[/p][/*][*][p]Feedback channels where your ideas can shape future updates[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/52JuSBvd5t"]Discord – Join our community, chat, and ask questions.[/url][/p][p][/p][p]See you there, and see you on release day! [/p][p]— Dotty Diaries[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860855/c5259104910e33edaf2daed6bf3a2be947d59cac.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Carnal Contract Release Delayed to August 27th
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I need to let you know about a small change to our release schedule for Carnal Contract. [/p][p][/p][p]The game is still in Steam’s REVIEW PROCESS, and unfortunately the approval is taking longer than expected.[/p][p][/p][p]Because of this, we won’t be able to launch on the original date.[/p][p][/p][p]The new planned release date is [b]August 27th[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]I know this is disappointing news, but the delay is only one week, and everything else on our side is fully ready. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for your patience and support![/p][p][/p][p]We’re almost there! [/p][p]-Dotty Diaries[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44860855/d7756a039fa3812156415723009da73191a4c3f0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 8 Days Until Release – The Final Countdown!
notes.notes: [p]We’ve hit [b]18,200 wishlists[/b]! [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for all the support so far. A strong wishlist count helps us tremendously at launch, so if you haven’t yet, please consider adding the game to your wishlist and sharing it with friends. Every single one makes a difference![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/2484170/extras/2f8b3e56496d63ace81a6681f80c8fd9.avif?t=1755024566"][/img][/p][h3][b]Translations[/b][/h3][p]We’re currently working hard on [b]Spanish[/b] and [b]Russian[/b] translations. Both are on track to be ready before our [b]August 20[/b] launch date. If, for any reason, they aren’t fully complete by release, they will be added shortly after in a[b] update[/b] so no one will have to wait long.[/p][p][/p][p]After launch, we’ll begin working on additional languages. If you’d like to see the game in your language, [b]drop a comment or start a discussion[/b] to let us know which one should be next![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Proofreading[/b][/h3][p]The entire script is going through a [b]final proofreading pass[/b] to make sure everything reads smoothly and any small errors are fixed before launch. This is part of our last quality push so the story feels as polished as possible on day one.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Walkthrough[/b][/h3][p]Since the game features [b]multiple love interests[/b] and choices that can change the story, we’re also preparing a [b]walkthrough[/b]. This will help players see exactly which choices to make depending on the outcome or scenes they want to experience. It will be available soon so everyone can explore the story the way they prefer.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Final Build & Steam Approval[/b][/h3][p]The final build is currently with Steam, awaiting approval. I’m hopeful it will be completed on time so we can avoid any delay to the launch.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2484170/Carnal_Contract/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3][b]Final Polish[/b][/h3][p]While Steam does it’s part, we’re using this time to do a [b]final polish pass[/b] on the game’s interface tweaking the [b]GUI[/b] for smoother navigation, cleaning up small visual inconsistencies, and making sure every screen feels as clean and professional as possible. [/p][p][/p][p]The countdown is officially on… just over a week to go before we open the doors.[/p][p][/p][p]p.s. [url="https://discord.com/invite/52JuSBvd5t"]Join us on Discord![/url][/p]
